+Proof. intros n H; induction H; auto. Qed.

+  lc_at (S k) t -> locally_closed u -> lc_at k (open_rec k u t).
+Proof.
+  intros k t. revert k.
+  induction t; intros k u Ht Hu; simpl in *; inversion Ht; subst; try constructor;
+    eauto using lc_weaken.
+  destruct (Nat.eqb k n) eqn:E; auto.
+  apply Nat.eqb_neq in E. constructor. lia.
+Qed.

+  lc_at k (open_rec k u t) -> lc_at (S k) t.

+Qed.

+  strongly_normalizing t'.

+Proof.
+  intros v Hv. constructor. intros v' Hs. inversion Hv; subst;
+    inversion Hs; subst; inversion H; subst; inversion H0.
+Qed.

+  locally_closed t /\\ strongly_normalizing t /\\

+Proof. intros T t H; destruct T; exact (proj1 (proj2 H)). Qed.

+  - intros v Hm Hv. inversion Hm; subst.
+    + inversion Hv; subst; auto; inversion H.
+    + destruct (Hall _ H) as [_ [_ Hval]]. apply Hval; auto.
+  - constructor; intros t' Hs. apply reducible_sn with (T:=Ty_Arrow T1 T2); eauto.
+  - intros v Hm Hv. inversion Hm; subst.
+    + inversion Hv; subst. exists t0; split; auto.
+      (* This value case is handled separately by the value introduction lemma. *)
+Abort.
